message:
The other day, I found myself in quite the pickle. It was one of those days when the weather app was more dramatic than a soap opera. A storm was brewing, and I thought, "I’ll just wing it!" 

Well, as the winds picked up and the skies turned ominous, I rummaged through my kitchen for snacks, only to realize my idea of prep was a half-eaten bag of gummy bears and a jar of pickles. 

Let’s just say, I might have survived, but my taste buds were in for an adventure! 

Now I keep a list of easy-to-grab snacks and essentials ready, just in case my inner optimist decides to take a day off. What’s your go-to tip for staying calm and ready when the weather gets a little wild? 🌪️
